historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2026 guidance-derived year-1 growth (3.0-3.5m units, Q3 revenue guide), not a historical CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Only FY2023-FY2025 exist (2-year CAGRs; 3- and 5-year are null). Equity 2-yr CAGR of 52% is almost entirely the Sep-2025 HK$4.2bn IPO proceeds, not retained earnings, and is not usable as a growth anchor. EPS went from -3.81 to +3.13 (pre-split basis) so no CAGR is defined. Owner FCF is negative in every year; SBC (RMB235m -> 115m) has fallen while reported FCF stayed negative, so the owner/reported gap has narrowed but the series still cannot anchor a growth rate.
historical_growth.notes: Revenue FY2023 1,877.0 -> FY2025 3,027.6 RMB m: 2-yr CAGR 27.0% (FY2025 +45.8% YoY, H1 FY2026 +25.1% YoY). Growth selection therefore leans on management's FY2026 unit guidance and the Q3 guide rather than any trailing CAGR.

scenario_narratives.base: Hesai converts its No.1 ADAS/robotics lidar position into ~RMB12bn revenue by FY2035 as unit growth (3.25m in FY2026, ~10m+ by the terminal year) outruns persistent ASP deflation; pre-SBC EBITDA margin climbs from ~12.5% to 20% once SGI breaks even and R&D scales; capex falls back to maintenance after the 4m-unit build; receivables keep growing with Chinese OEM revenue (WC -35% of growth) so owner FCF only turns positive around FY2028. About RMB4.9/share (HK$5.8) of the value is the net cash pile.
scenario_narratives.bull: Multi-lidar L3 content, overseas OEM wins, >1m robotics units and a recurring SGI/Kosmo software stream push growth to 40%/35% in FY2026-27 and mature EBITDA margin to 24%; share leadership is defended through architecture convergence and the 1260H overhang is removed.
scenario_narratives.bear: ASP erosion and Huawei/RoboSense share gains cap growth at 22% then single digits; gross margin slides to the low-30s and EBITDA margin stalls at 13%; geopolitical action (Entity List / 1260H) strands overseas investment; working capital keeps absorbing cash so FCF stays negative to FY2029 and the equity is worth little more than net cash.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A fresh-build owner-FCF DCF on a pre-FCF-inflection hardware growth company with 2.5 years of history. The model refuses to anchor on the (negative) historical FCF or on FY2025 reported profit, which was carried by grants, a one-off securities gain and interest income; instead it builds FY2026 from unit guidance and the H1 FY2026 margin run-rate, charges SBC as a cost (house basis), strips interest and investment income because the RMB7.1bn financial-asset pile is added back in the bridge, models working capital as a drag on growth (manufacturer sign), ramps cash tax to the 15% HNTE rate as NOLs are consumed, caps the terminal multiple at 15x, and prices geopolitical and competitive risk in the bear flows and a 25% bear weight rather than in the discount rate. Values are computed in RMB and reported in HKD at CNYHKD 1.1724; the HSAI ADS (8 shares per ADS post-subdivision) is the parity check.
key_risks_to_valuation: ASP deflation outrunning unit growth: FY2025 revenue/unit RMB1,869 -> H1 FY2026 RMB1,401 (-25%); each further 10pp of annual ASP decline not offset by volume removes roughly a year of growth from the path
China lidar share loss to Huawei and RoboSense (Xiaomi dual-sourcing); installation-based share already compressing from the mid-40s toward the mid-30s
US regulatory tail: DoD 1260H list (remanded, not vacated), SDNY securities suit, latent Commerce Entity List / export-control risk on the ASIC supply chain and HFCAA pressure on the Nasdaq line

Working-capital absorption: receivables and inventory consumed ~50% of FY2025 revenue growth; if Chinese OEM payment terms do not improve the base case's -35% capture is too generous and FCF inflection slips beyond FY2028
Government grants (RMB143m FY2025, ~4.7% of revenue) and HNTE 15% tax status are policy-dependent; the margin path treats grants as fading, not disappearing

Net cash is ~45% of the current market value: any large acquisition, SGI cash burn beyond guidance or a persistent FX loss on the USD/HKD-denominated proceeds (H1 FY2026 FX loss RMB47m) directly reduces the bridge
The quote fell ~20% in the week to 2026-10-16 for a reason not visible in the filings on hand; the price anchor should be refreshed and the cause checked before acting

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted at 2026-06-30 on the post-subdivision basis (8-for-1 share subdivision effective 2026-07-10, applied retrospectively in the interim): 215,990,888 Class A + 1,038,510,104 Class B = 1,254.5m issued, plus 52.7m treasury-method incremental shares from options/RSUs per interim Note 16 (diluted weighted average 1,303.7m). Class A and B carry identical economic rights (WVR differs only in votes). Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows; charging both would double-count. The 1,845,704 anti-dilutive options are ignored.
inputs.cash_composition: 2026-06-30 interim balance sheet, RMB m: cash and equivalents 1,510.1 + restricted cash 13.4 + short-term investments 5,139.7 (time deposits 4,563.1, structured bank products 100.3, fund investments 441.3, listed equity securities 35.0 at fair value) + long-term time deposits 422.3 (Note 8). The RMB30.0m cost-basis unlisted equity investment is excluded. Total debt is short-term borrowings 395.5 (of which 270.0 is a facility secured on discounted notes receivable) + long-term bank borrowings 242.0; operating lease liabilities (98.5) are EXCLUDED because lease cost is already inside operating expenses under US GAAP (treatment B).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 Annual Report consolidated cash flow statement, 'Share-based compensation' RMB114,652 thousand (line 4887); cross-checks to the statement of changes in equity (line 4833). No cash taxes paid on net-share settlement are disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes 0), so the combined figure equals the add-back.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 interest income RMB130.2m (income statement line 4754) stripped because the RMB7.1bn financial-asset pile is added back in full in net cash; H1 FY2026 interest income was already RMB115.8m plus RMB36.6m investment income, so the FY2026 run-rate (~RMB250m+) would otherwise be a large phantom contributor to FCF.
inputs.buyback_note: No repurchases in any period; the flat count is a modelling convention the company has not paid for in cash. Net issuance is from option exercises and the Sep-2025 HK IPO (both already in the 1,307.2m count).
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1724 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-16T22:01Z. All flows and per-share values are computed in RMB and converted to HKD at this rate; unsuffixed intrinsic_value/weighted_iv are in HKD (quote currency), *_cny twins are the model currency. Parity check against the Nasdaq ADS (HSAI): one ADS represents 8 subdivided Class B shares since the 2026-07-10 subdivision (previously 1:1). HSAI closed US$13.36 on 2026-10-15 x USDHKD 7.8479 / 8 = HK$13.11, a 1.4% gap to the 2525.HK regular close recorded as current_price at inputs.price_as_of; HSAI fell a further 7% to US$12.42 during US hours on 2026-10-16, so the next HK session should open below that close. Direction and ratio confirmed.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z regular HK close (Yahoo chart meta regularMarketPrice). VOLATILE: the HK quote and HSAI ADS both fell ~20% over 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-16 to the 52-week low (52w range 12.78-28.85 post-split); the cause is not in the filings on hand and the price should be refreshed at the next regular close. Yahoo's HK daily bars for 10-13..10-16 are zero-volume placeholders (15.47) and are NOT the quote.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: 10-year China Government Bond ~1.8% + equity risk premium for China-listed equities ~6.3% x beta ~1.3 for a single-product auto/robotics component maker = ~10% cost of equity; debt is immaterial (RMB637m vs RMB7.1bn financial assets) so WACC = 10.0%. No ad-hoc premium for geopolitical/1260H risk or ASP erosion: those are charged once, in the bear scenario flows and the 25% bear weight (adaptations file, section f). One WACC across all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B): US GAAP filer; operating lease expense (RMB24.4m non-cash lease expense FY2025) is inside operating expenses and the cash payments run through operating cash flow, so lease cost is already in the EBITDA margin path. Lease liabilities (RMB98.5m at 2026-06-30) are excluded from total_debt. No lease_cost_pct_path is used because nothing is being moved.
inputs.nci_treatment: None: no non-controlling interests; net income attributable equals consolidated net income in every period.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, scenario-weighted, component route (SKILL.md row 1: operating company, tech hardware) with the non-US adaptations (CNY flows vs HKD quote, leases, excluded-income/matching-asset rule). Hesai is an operating lidar manufacturer; nothing in the business straddles a non-FCF row. FRESH BUILD (no prior DCF or Drivers file, no MEMORY.md entry). WHY A STANDARD MID-CYCLE FCF ANCHOR DOES NOT WORK HERE: only 2.5 years of history (FY2023-H1 FY2026) and owner FCF has been negative every year (FY2023 -692, FY2024 -428, FY2025 -470 RMB m) because receivables and inventory grow faster than revenue and capex is running at ~11% of revenue for the 4m-unit capacity build and the Thailand plant. The historical FCF series therefore cannot anchor growth or margin; last_fcf is reported for auditability only and the model is a 10-year component build anchored on (i) the FY2026 guidance (3.0-3.5m lidar units vs 1.62m in FY2025; Q3 FY2026 revenue RMB1,100-1,150m, +38-45% YoY; SGI revenue RMB200-300m), (ii) the H1 FY2026 actual gross margin (39.7%) and opex run-rate, and (iii) the FY2025 cash-flow components. FY2025 REPORTED PROFIT IS FLATTERED: operating income RMB168.8m includes RMB181.4m 'other operating income, net' (RMB143.4m government grants); net income RMB435.9m additionally includes a RMB175.6m one-off gain on disposal of equity securities, a RMB37.0m IP-transfer gain and RMB130.2m interest income. Pre-SBC EBITDA FY2025 = 168.8 + 123.8 D&A + 114.7 SBC = RMB407.2m (13.4% incl. grants; ~8.7% ex grants); H1 FY2026 pre-SBC EBITDA ~RMB119m (7.7%, seasonally weak half plus SGI start-up losses). The EBITDA margin path is on the reported basis (grants included, since they recur for a PRC high-tech enterprise but are assumed to fade as a share of revenue) and lease cost is inside it. ASP: FY2025 revenue/unit RMB1,869 (1.62m units); H1 FY2026 RMB1,401 (1.10m units), -25% YoY; the growth paths assume unit growth continues to outrun ASP erosion but at a narrowing gap. WORKING CAPITAL: FY2025 operating asset/liability changes consumed RMB476m against +RMB950m revenue growth (-50% capture); FY2024 -68%. The build uses -35% base / -25% bull / -45% bear on the revenue CHANGE, i.e. growth consumes cash (manufacturer sign). TAX: cash taxes paid RMB3.5m FY2025, RMB722m of NOL carryforwards (annual report line 7189) and 15% HNTE preferential rate; cash tax ramps 2% -> 15% over the horizon (bear 18% to allow for partial loss of HNTE status / 25% statutory on non-qualifying entities). Terminal cap 15x FCF (not 20x) because this is a hardware component supplier with structural price deflation, not a software compounder. Horizon 10 years because the owner-FCF margin is still ramping at year 5 in every scenario (section 2d).
inputs.guidance_anchor: FY2026: total lidar shipments 3.0-3.5m units (raised); Q3 FY2026 revenue RMB1,100-1,150m; SGI revenue RMB200-300m (raised from 100m), SGI ~US$100m and breakeven in FY2027; robotics shipments >500k units; capacity >4m units. H1 FY2026 actual revenue RMB1,541m (+25%); implied FY2026 revenue ~RMB4.0-4.1bn (+33-35%) taking Q3 at the midpoint and Q4 at a similar YoY rate.

bear.narrative: Shipments land at the bottom of guidance (3.0m) and ASP erosion (-30%+/yr) nearly cancels volume growth: FY2026 revenue +22%, then Huawei and RoboSense (Xiaomi dual-sourcing) push Hesai's China share from ~44% toward the low-30s and the market commoditises toward RMB500-800 units; a Commerce Entity List action or an adverse 1260H outcome closes US/allied OEM and robotics channels, stranding part of the Thailand capex; SGI never reaches scale and is wound back. Gross margin drifts to the low-30s and pre-SBC EBITDA margin stalls at ~13%; Chinese OEM payment terms keep stretching (WC capture -45%); HNTE status is only partly retained (18% cash tax). Owner FCF stays negative for the first four years and the equity value is mostly the net cash pile.

base.narrative: FY2026 revenue ~RMB4.06bn (+34%): shipments at the ~3.25m midpoint with revenue/unit falling a further ~25-30% to ~RMB1,150-1,200, plus RMB250m SGI. Growth decelerates to 4% by year 10 as ADAS lidar penetration in China saturates and ASP deflation continues; robotics and overseas OEMs keep volume growing. Pre-SBC EBITDA margin (grants included, lease cost inside) 12.5% in FY2026 (H2-weighted, SGI losses) ramping to 20% as SGI breaks even in FY2027 and R&D/G&A scale on a ~38-40% gross margin. Capex 9% -> 4.5% once the 4m-unit capacity and Thailand plant are built; D&A rises to 5% then converges on capex. Working capital consumes 35% of each year's revenue increase (improving from -50% FY2025 as robotics/overseas mix shortens receivable days). Cash tax 2% -> 15% HNTE rate as the RMB722m NOLs are used.

bull.narrative: Shipments at the top of guidance (3.5m) and L3 multi-lidar configurations (3-6 units per vehicle) lift content per vehicle faster than ASP falls; Volkswagen/GAC Toyota/Great Wall programmes and the Thailand plant make overseas a meaningful second leg; robotics (humanoid, lawn-mower backlog with Dreame/MOVA, robotaxi) exceeds 1m units/yr by FY2028 at higher margins; SGI (Kosmo, actuation modules) reaches ~US$100m and breakeven in FY2027 and becomes a recurring software stream. Hesai holds ~40%+ China share as architecture convergence favours the scale leader. Pre-SBC EBITDA margin reaches 24%; receivable days improve with overseas mix (WC capture -25%). The 1260H listing is formally vacated after the D.C. Circuit remand, removing the US counterparty overhang.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: two independent high-severity tails (US 1260H/Entity-List/tariff escalation on a China-headquartered dual-listed issuer, and a China lidar price war in which Huawei and RoboSense are visibly taking share while ASP halves) plus a working-capital model that has kept owner FCF negative for three years. Bull cut from 35% to 25%: it needs several independent things to go right at once (robotics/humanoid volume, overseas OEM ramps, SGI reaching scale, 1260H removal) and the H1 FY2026 margin compression argues against a quick margin lift. Base 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
